about: The PAELEO threshold score: one description, many operations. Every handmade version keeps these choices at these times (±0.25 s), the dog never enters the house (x ≥ 0.56 m), and its refusal shows its back.

units.x: metres along the porch; the threshold is x = 0, inside is negative, the porch steps are at 4.9

act_meaning.turn: 1 faces the person and the door, −1 its back turned
act_meaning.head: 0 down, 1 up and alert
act_meaning.look: 1 head turned in through the door
act_meaning.walk_phase: radians; feet move with distance travelled

prompts: call again, and reach for it.
say it softly: it's all right.

choices.why: threat 1.00 and already 4.3 m away: turns its back
pressure 0.20 gone, invitation 1.00: turns back to look
trust 0.60 > 0.6, threat 0.00, threshold clear: comes closer
reached the sill: lies down there, half in and half out
